changeinfo.changes:
• Minor level fixes
  • Slight changes to some menus
  • Improved performance and graphics
  • Made the activity stream easier to use
  • Fixes to skill rewards on level badges
  • Fixes to skill rewards when copying levels on My Moon

• Additional downloadable costume support
  • Improved stability
  • Locked levels are now fully locked
  • Update All function can now be used

• Fix for issue where loading times would become excessively long
  • Fix for a GPU crash that would occur in create
  • Fix for a bug where the popit would never open in the pod if the user had closed the game during the pod introduction sequence
  • Fix for a crash that occurred frequently due to a memory leak
  • Fix for emitted objects becoming corrupt and unusable when used in a different level than the level they were captured in
  • Fix for locked levels being accessible through the recent activity search function

• Support for additional DLC costumes
  • Interface update to accommodate additional content
  • Fix for freeze when deleting a large number of downloaded levels
  • Locked levels can now be unhearted
  • Improved browsing of Cool Levels
  • Fix to stop a blank photo page appearing on community levels
  • News feeds will no longer display when empty
  • Declining the EULA will now be saved throughout all game areas
  • Fix to remove PlayStation®Store icon staying on screen in certain situations
  • Additional improved stability updates

• Additional DLC costumes and stickers
  • Reduced audio skipping during download operations

• Updated firmware support
  • PlayStation®Vita system firmware Player matchmaking
  • Additional support for DLC and stickers
